title: Jimmy Kimmel Clocks Trump’s Personal Investment in Jensen Huang
summary: The late night host pointed to President Trump’s haranguing of the Nvidia board on Huang’s behalf: “And if you think that sounds fishy, it’s not — it’s called being a good friend.”
